action.option: Escalate the 2005-2015 temperature decline for follow-up

brief_basis: Chart_1 shows a continuous decline from 24 in 2005 to 10 in 2015, a 14-unit drop over the review period. The routing criterion is magnitude of change across the review period under the substantial trend workflow. A 14-unit decline is substantial, warranting escalation for follow-up.
